title.zh: 犯罪资产追回修正命令 2020

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-26-2020-CRIMINAL-ASSET-RECOVERY-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2020.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Criminal Asset Recovery (Amendment) of new section 139A into S 47/2012

The Criminal Asset Recovery Order, 2012 is amended by inserting the new section immediately after section 139 - of offences 139A. (1) The Authority may compound any offence under this Order or any regulations made thereunder which is prescribed as a compoundable by collecting from a person reasonably suspected of having the offence a sum of money not exceeding one half of the maximum fine prescribed for that offence.

(2) On payment of such sum of money referred to in subsection (1), no further proceedings shall be taken against that person in respect of the

(3) The Authority may make regulations to prescribe the offences may be compounded.

(4) All sums collected by the Authority under subsection (1) shall be paid to the Authority". Made this 6th. day of Ramadhan, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of April, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM. oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
